premise: The prison's locks initially protect survivors, then turn every escape route into a negotiation. The central conflict is who controls the route, rather than another broken radio.
cast: Patch: existing bandage identity, white head/hands/feet, orange grounded school backpack.
Nia: adult kitchen worker, olive work apron, white head/hands/feet, black stick limbs.
Cal: adult inmate, charcoal prison clothing, white head/hands/feet; courtyard key.
Vale: older adult guard, initially grey uniform then kitchen jacket; white head/hands/feet; cough and later limp persist.
Infected guards/inmates: pale-green heads, hands and exposed feet; ordinary simplified black limbs.
locations: Visitor cell -> reception -> staff hall -> kitchen.
Cafeteria is infected; rear staff passage avoids it and reaches Cal's courtyard gate.
Administrative fire wing connects through separation door; resealed after Vale arrives.
Courtyard -> loading passage -> failed transport vehicle -> narrow rear gap -> laundry.
Laundry exit crosses perimeter wall to service road, fields and inspected church shelter.
chronology: Days1-2: cell, key retrieval, guard follows inside before cell is locked.
Days2-10: kitchen supplies, gated food/access trade and blocked loading route.
Days11-15: Vale rescued from fire; old service route lost.
Days16-21: infected pressure, water-container loss, cooperation and vehicle inspection.
Days22-26: equipment clearing; vehicle trial fails; Cal shares gate key.
Days27-29: laundry route tested; infected group outside delays departure until dawn.
Day30: four leave, walk fields, enter church shelter.
setups_and_payoffs: Cell key solves first confinement; shared key access resolves Cal's control conflict.
Planted laundry exit becomes escape after transport attempt fails.
Food sharing progresses from conditional trade to taking injured Vale along.
persistent_states: Nia recovers reception/kitchen key ring; Cal's courtyard key is a separate object.
Guard actually enters original cell before Nia locks him inside.
Fire-wing door sealed after rescue; no later shortcut through it.
Transport vehicle damages its front corner and remains unusable across loading.
Backpack pocket catches on van bumper and is freed; small damage persists.
Gate key is handed to Nia rather than mysteriously discarded or duplicated.
Four adults survive and walk out; Vale still limps.
visual_reference_status: Use existing preset main/drawing guide; prepare and inspect recurring side-character and new-location references before scenes.
